item.name: Intern
item.cardSummary: The free starter class. Extra opening sanity is the whole perk, so it is ideal while you learn check-ins and treatment routes.

item.name: Nurse
item.bestFor: Carrying more tools for the team
item.cardSummary: A cheap support pick that expands how many items you can hold. Strong for players who ferry treatments, coffee, and extinguishers.

item.name: Secretary
item.level1Perk: Recover 1 sanity when checking in patients
item.level2Perk: Recover sanity on check-in, plus 5 bonus starting sanity
item.level3Perk: Recover sanity on check-in, plus 10 bonus starting sanity
item.cardSummary: Rewards staying on reception. Every clean check-in tops up sanity, so it fits desk mains more than hallway runners.

item.name: Doctor
item.level2Perk: Recover sanity when healing, plus 15 bonus starting sanity
item.level3Perk: Recover sanity when healing, plus 20 bonus starting sanity
item.cardSummary: Sanity comes back when you finish healing. Best for players who live in patient rooms more than at the window.

item.name: Psychologist
item.level1Perk: All sanity gains and losses are doubled
item.level2Perk: Doubled sanity effects, plus 7.5% chance to ignore sanity loss
item.level3Perk: Doubled sanity effects, plus 15% chance to ignore sanity loss
item.cardSummary: Every sanity hit and heal hits harder. Strong when you control coffee and threats well, rough when you take random damage.

item.name: Surgeon
item.level1Perk: Gain sanity and a short speed boost after healing a patient
item.level2Perk: Gain sanity and a longer (8s) speed boost after healing
item.level3Perk: Double sanity recovery and a longer (8s) speed boost after healing, plus 10 bonus starting sanity
item.cardSummary: Healing patients pays you back with sanity and speed. A top late-game coin class for players who clear rooms nonstop.

item.name: Paramedic
item.level1Perk: Start with Large Speed Cola (6 uses)
item.level2Perk: Start with Large Speed Cola (9 uses)
item.level3Perk: Start with Large Speed Cola (9 uses) that regenerates 1 use each round
item.cardSummary: Built for emergencies that spawn across the map. The cola starter lets you reach fires, faints, and rituals before the timer ends.

item.name: Security
item.level3Perk: Start with X-Taser (6 uses) that regenerates 1 use each round
item.cardSummary: Opens the shift armed. The multi-use taser is perfect for clearing hostiles without sprinting back to the shop box.

item.name: Head Nurse
item.level2Perk: +3 max inventory capacity and +10 bonus starting sanity
item.level3Perk: +3 max inventory capacity and start each round with the Special Technique upgrade
item.cardSummary: A Robux support class with big inventory and later-round utility. Sources list the Robux price slightly differently, so check the lobby shop before buying.

item.name: Secret Agent
item.level2Perk: Start with a gun (30 uses) and +10 bonus starting sanity
item.level3Perk: Start with a gun (30 uses) that regenerates 1 use each round, plus 20 bonus starting sanity
item.cardSummary: The premium combat pick. A loaded gun makes shapeshifters, ghosts, and other threats much safer to handle. Confirm the current Robux price in the class shop.
